name: "multi-search-engine"
description: "Multi search engine integration with 17 engines (8 CN + 9 Global). Supports advanced search operators, time filters, site search, privacy engines, and WolframAlpha knowledge queries. No API keys required."
---

# Multi Search Engine v2.0.1

Integration of 17 search engines for web crawling without API keys.

## Search Engines

### Domestic (8)
- **Baidu**: `https://www.baidu.com/s?wd={keyword}`
- **Bing CN**: `https://cn.bing.com/search?q={keyword}&ensearch=0`
- **Bing INT**: `https://cn.bing.com/search?q={keyword}&ensearch=1`
- **360**: `https://www.so.com/s?q={keyword}`
- **Sogou**: `https://sogou.com/web?query={keyword}`
- **WeChat**: `https://wx.sogou.com/weixin?type=2&query={keyword}`
- **Toutiao**: `https://so.toutiao.com/search?keyword={keyword}`
- **Jisilu**: `https://www.jisilu.cn/explore/?keyword={keyword}`

### International (9)
- **Google**: `https://www.google.com/search?q={keyword}`
- **Google HK**: `https://www.google.com.hk/search?q={keyword}`
- **DuckDuckGo**: `https://duckduckgo.com/html/?q={keyword}`
- **Yahoo**: `https://search.yahoo.com/search?p={keyword}`
- **Startpage**: `https://www.startpage.com/sp/search?query={keyword}`
- **Brave**: `https://search.brave.com/search?q={keyword}`
- **Ecosia**: `https://www.ecosia.org/search?q={keyword}`
- **Qwant**: `https://www.qwant.com/?q={keyword}`
- **WolframAlpha**: `https://www.wolframalpha.com/input?i={keyword}`

## Quick Examples

```javascript
// Basic search
web_fetch({"url": "https://www.google.com/search?q=python+tutorial"})

// Site-specific
web_fetch({"url": "https://www.google.com/search?q=site:github.com+react"})

// File type
web_fetch({"url": "https://www.google.com/search?q=machine+learning+filetype:pdf"})

// Time filter (past week)
web_fetch({"url": "https://www.google.com/search?q=ai+news&tbs=qdr:w"})

// Privacy search
web_fetch({"url": "https://duckduckgo.com/html/?q=privacy+tools"})

// DuckDuckGo Bangs
web_fetch({"url": "https://duckduckgo.com/html/?q=!gh+tensorflow"})

// Knowledge calculation
web_fetch({"url": "https://www.wolframalpha.com/input?i=100+USD+to+CNY"})
```

## Advanced Operators

| Operator | Example | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| `site:` | `site:github.com python` | Search within site |
| `filetype:` | `filetype:pdf report` | Specific file type |
| `""` | `"machine learning"` | Exact match |
| `-` | `python -snake` | Exclude term |
| `OR` | `cat OR dog` | Either term |

## Time Filters

| Parameter | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `tbs=qdr:h` | Past hour |
| `tbs=qdr:d` | Past day |
| `tbs=qdr:w` | Past week |
| `tbs=qdr:m` | Past month |
| `tbs=qdr:y` | Past year |

## Privacy Engines

- **DuckDuckGo**: No tracking
- **Startpage**: Google results + privacy
- **Brave**: Independent index
- **Qwant**: EU GDPR compliant

## Bangs Shortcuts (DuckDuckGo)

| Bang | Destination |
|------|-------------|
| `!g` | Google |
| `!gh` | GitHub |
| `!so` | Stack Overflow |
| `!w` | Wikipedia |
| `!yt` | YouTube |

## WolframAlpha Queries

- Math: `integrate x^2 dx`
- Conversion: `100 USD to CNY`
- Stocks: `AAPL stock`
- Weather: `weather in Beijing`

## Documentation

- `references/advanced-search.md` - Domestic search guide
- `references/international-search.md` - International search guide
- `CHANGELOG.md` - Version history

January

- January 29: She makes an appearance in the Early Show in CBS at 7AM ET.

- January 31: 52nd Grammy Awards in Los Angeles, California. It will be broadcasted on CBS, 8pm -11:30pm ET/PT. Taylor is nominated for 8 awards and scheduled to perform. She won 4: Best Country Song, Best Female Country Vocal, Best Country Album and Album of the Year 🙂

May

September

- September 1: The remaining categories of the CMA nominations are announced by Miranda Lambert and Dierks Bentley on Good Morning America.

- September 1: [CMA Music Festival: Country’s Night To Rock](http://www.cmafest.com/) airs on ABC at 8/7c.

- September 9: Taylor Swift will perform at kickoff time in New Orleans for the Saints vs. Vikings game to be broadcast on NBC at 7:30pm ET.

- September 12: [MTV Video Music Awards](http://www.mtv.com/ontv/vma/2010/) airs on MTV at 9/8c. Taylor Swift was nominated for Female Video of the Year for Fifteen. Lady Gaga won it. Taylor performs Innocent for the first time ever, a song dedicated to the previous VMA incident and forgiveness.

- September 18: Tickets go on sale for the [44th CMA Awards](http://www.cmaawards.com/), which takes place November 10.

- September 21: Voting period ends for [J-14 Teen Icon Awards](http://www.j-14.com/2010/09/introducing-j-14s-teen-icon-awards-official-nominations.html).

- September 22: Voting period ends for the [Country Weekly](http://www.countryweekly.com/sexiest_2010/vote/surveys/723) most beautiful woman in country music.

- September 23: Taylor Swift performs at the [All For The Hall fundraiser at Club Nokia](http://www.clubnokia.com/eventdetail.php?id=28714), Los Angeles that benefits the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum.

- September 27: Taylor Swift visits Milan, Italy.

- September 28: She is scheduled to perform on X-Factor Italy.

- September 29: She attends Roberto Cavalli’s 40th Anniversary gala dinner and party at Ecole Superiure des Beaux Arts in Paris, France.

- September 30: Taylor Swift is scheduled for an interview at [NRJ](http://www.nrj.fr/music-509/exclus-nrj-526/article/249731-taylor-swift-en-interview-dans-le-6-9-gagne-tes-places-.html) in Paris, France. You can [enter the contest](http://www.nrj.fr/music-509/exclus-nrj-526/article/249731-taylor-swift-en-interview-dans-le-6-9-gagne-tes-places-.html) to be part of the audience.

October

- October 1: CMT’s [Speak Now with Taylor Swift in New York City](http://winwithtaylor.com/) contest registration closes.

- October 4:Speak Now will get a 30-second preview on Comcast On Demand and [XfinityTv.com](http://www.xfinitytv.com/) starting one minute past midnight. E! News will show a clip and interview in the evening.

- October 5:Speak Now goes on sale on iTunes.

- October 9: Taylor Swift performs at the [Grand Ole Opry](http://search2.opry.com/?view=events&q=Taylor)! Dolly Parton performs on the very same night! [Get your tickets now](http://search2.opry.com/?view=events&q=Taylor).

- October 11:Back To December will get a 30-second preview on Comcast On Demand and [XfinityTv.com](http://www.xfinitytv.com/) starting one minute past midnight. E! News will show a clip and interview in the evening.

- October 12:Back To December goes on sale on iTunes. The Glamour magazine with Taylor Swift’s interview, photoshoot and cover comes out in newsstands.

- October 18:Mean will get a 30-second preview on Comcast On Demand and [XfinityTv.com](http://www.xfinitytv.com/) starting one minute past midnight. E! News will show a clip and interview in the evening.

- October 18: Taylor Swift performs in a private concert at a secret location in Paris! Promoted by [Goom Radio](http://www.goomradio.fr/#page=radio/just-hits/2010/10/07/taylor-swift-en-showcase--gagne-tes-invits).

- October 18: Royal Caribbean International launches its contest [The Allure of Taylor Swift](http://theallureoftaylor.com/#). You win a 7-night cruise for two on the Bahamas including two tickets for Taylor’s on board concert. The promotion period starts now and runs until October 29. The cruise dates are tentatively scheduled for January 16-23, 2011. Sorry, only US residents eligible.

- October 19:Mean goes on sale on iTunes.

- October 22: The ticket sales for the UK concerts on March 22, 29 and 30 of 2011 open on [SeeTickets](http://www2.seetickets.com/see/event.asp?artist=TAYLOR+SWIFT). [Play.com](http://www.play.com/Music/CD/4-/15957600/Speak-Now/Product.html) will give you a ticket pre-sales code if you pre-order the [Speak Now CD](http://www.play.com/Music/CD/4-/15957600/Speak-Now/Product.html) or [Speak Now Deluxe Edition CD](http://www.play.com/Music/CD/4-/16686744/Speak-Now/Product.html)! More at [Play.com](http://www.play.com/Music/CD/4-/15957600/Speak-Now/Product.html).

- October 22: Taylor Swift appears on [Paul O’Grady Live](http://www.itv.com/paulogrady) in London, England.

- October 22, 23 and 24: Taylor Swift’s Journey To Fearless premieres on [The Hub](http://www.hubworld.com/) network.

- October 22: Story Of Us will get a 30-second preview on Comcast On Demand and [XfinityTv.com](http://www.xfinitytv.com/) starting one minute past midnight. E! News will show the clip in the evening.

- October 23: Last chance to send your video entries for the [Team Hug](http://www.teamhug.org/)contest! Closes at 5pm Eastern time.

- October 25: Speak Now WORLDWIDE DATE RELEASE on iTunes and on major music retailers around the world.

- October 25: Tickets go on sale for a lot of tour concert dates! See February and March for ticket links.

- October 25: [103.7 KISS-FM](http://www.1037kissfm.com/) in Milwaukee will be [taken over](http://wxss.taylorswifttakeover.com/) by Taylor Swift at noon.

- October 25: A group of winners of contests held around the world will join Taylor for a private performance at the United Nations in New York City. [Taylor Swift Live Stream from New York City](http://www.cmt.com/shows/events/taylor_swift_live_stream/) will be available on many of MTV Networks’ web properties, including CMT.com, MTV.com, VH1.com and websites across Europe, Asia, Australia and Latin America at 7PM Eastern, 6PM Central. Now also available on [Ustream](http://www.ustream.tv/taylorswift).

- October 25: Taylor Swift takes over [Dial-Global Hot Country Forum](http://www.dial-global.com/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=244:taylor-swift-takes-over-dial-globals-hot-country-format&catid=1:on-the-dial-press&Itemid=92) from 8pm to 9pm EST.

- October 26: Taylor will perform live for fans from Rockefeller Plaza on the [Today Show](http://today.msnbc.msn.com/) as part of their fall concert series. Fans can apply for passes to the show at: [http://today.msnbc.msn.com/id/30012397](http://today.msnbc.msn.com/id/30012397) . That night, she will do an interview and performance on the [Late Show with David Letterman](http://www.cbs.com/late_night/late_show/). The [Today Show](http://today.msnbc.msn.com/) airs on NBC from 7:00 – 11:00 a.m. (all time zones), and [Late Show with David Letterman](http://www.cbs.com/late_night/late_show/) airs on CBS at 11:30 p.m. (ET/PT).

- October 27: Taylor’s day starts with [Live! With Regis & Kelly](http://regisandkelly.go.com/) where she will do an interview and performance. The show airs on ABC affiliates nationwide, check for listings by area. That afternoon, she will visit Scholastic’s New York headquarters, where she will take time out from her busy release week schedule for a special literacy event, [Read Now! with Taylor Swift](http://www.scholastic.com/readeveryday/readnow.htm), as part of the company’s 90th Anniversary Literacy campaign ([register here](http://vxlive.feedroom.com/feedroom/http/4000/5172/5174/7045/Lobby/default.htm)). Later in the day, she will visit Madame Tussaud’s New York – the famed Times Square wax attraction — for the unveiling of her original wax figure.

- October 27: Taylor will now be appearing at the JetBlue terminal, Gate 14 (there is no Gate 13, superstitious much?) at Kennedy International Airport in New York City on Wednesday, October 27. Taylor Swift has a chartered flight from New York to Los Angeles with very lucky fans included and even an improvised concert during the flight.

- October 28:[Ellen DeGeneres Show](http://ellen.warnerbros.com/) will celebrate the release of Speak Now by once again devoting an entire hour-long show to throwing Taylor’s official album release party. Participate in Ellen’s [Ultimate Taylor Swift Fan](http://ellen.warnerbros.com/show/respond/?PlugID=463#ixzz12O0vM7jI) contest!

- October 29: Taylor Swift performs at Hollywood and Highland in Los Angeles, California.

- October 29: The Royal Caribbean International contest [The Allure of Taylor Swift](http://theallureoftaylor.com/#) entry period closes. The cruise dates are tentatively scheduled for January 16-23, 2011. Sorry, only US residents eligible.

November

- November 1: The Speak Now Album Release Party will air on the [Ellen DeGeneres Show](http://ellen.warnerbros.com/) on Monday, November 1st (syndicated, check local listings).

- November 2: Taylor will perform on [Dancing With the Stars](http://abc.go.com/shows/dancing-with-the-stars), airing on ABC at 9:00 p.m. (ET/PT).

- November 4: Taylor gets interviewed on CTV’s Canada AM. Enter 99.9FM’s [contest to be in the audience](http://toronto.virginradio.ca/Channels/listentowin/Story.aspx?ID=1303207)!

- November 4: Taylor Swift will be at the [MuchMusic](http://blog.muchmusic.com/taylor-swift-is-coming-to-muchmusic/) building in Toronto, Canada at 5pm Eastern time.

- November 9: The [BMI Awards](http://www.bmi.com/press/entry/548690).

- November 10: The 44th Annual [CMA Awards](http://www.cmaawards.com/) ceremony takes place live from the Bridgestone Arena in Nashville, TN. The event airs on ABC at 8/7c. Taylor Swift is nominated for Female Vocalist of the Year. She also is scheduled to perform. Update: She lost to Miranda Lambert.

- November 11: The CMA Country Christmas is taped. Taylor is not scheduled to appear but it’s still a major Country Music show.

- November 14: Taylor is scheduled to perform at the [BBC Radio 1’s Teen Awards](http://www.bbc.co.uk/radio1/teenawards/2010/about/).

- November 16: Speak Now is released on vinyl.

- November 17: TV appearance on [Fuji TV/SmapXSmap Japan TV](http://www.fujitv.co.jp/en/).

- November 18: TV appearance on [Nippon TV/Zoom In Japan TV](http://www.ntv.co.jp/english/).

- November 21: The [American Music Awards](http://abc.go.com/shows/american-music-awards) are broadcast live on ABC at 8pm Eastern time. The winners will be decided via online voting through [ABC.com](http://www.ama.abc.com/) and [AMAvote.com](http://www.amavote.com/). Taylor Swift is nominated for Favorite Female Country Artist. Update! Voting is now closed.

- November 22: Taylor Swift will appear on the Tonight Show with Jay Leno. Check your local TV listings.

- November 24: Taylor Swift’s performance of Back To December will air on The Ellen Degeneres Show. Check your local TV listings.

- November 24: Taylor Swift will appear on the Chelsea Lately show. Check your local TV listings.

- November 25: “Taylor Swift – Speak Now” will document the days of the Speak Now album release including a trip from New York City to Los Angeles, her multiple performances, behind the scenes footage and her concert 30,000 feet in the air on a plane ride across the country. The special airs on [NBC](http://www.nbc.com/) at 8PM Eastern Time.

December

- December 1: [E! Entertainment Special](http://www.eonline.com) on Taylor Swift at 10pm Eastern time.

- December 3: Atlanta, Los Angeles, San Jose, Sacramento and Toronto are on sale to the general public on [Ticketmaster](http://www.ticketmaster.com/search?q=taylor+swift) at 10:00am.

- December 3: The first ever [CMT Artists of the Year](http://www.cmt.com/shows/events/artists-of-the-year/index.jhtml) airing Dec. 3 at 8/7c on CMT. Taylor Swift is among the honored ones.

- December 4: Foxborough is on sale to the general public on [Ticketmaster](http://www.ticketmaster.com/search?q=taylor+swift) at 10:00am. Montreal is on sale at [Evenko](http://www.evenko.ca/en/show/event/taylor-swift-4842).

- December 4: The voting for the [American Country Awards](http://theacas.com/vote-artistawards.php) closes. You can vote at [theacas.com](http://theacas.com/vote-artistawards.php). Taylor is up for Artist of the Year: Female and Touring Artist of the Year. [Vote vote vote](http://theacas.com/vote-artistawards.php)!

- December 6: The first ever [American Country Awards](http://theacas.com/vote-artistawards.php) show will air on the Fox Network. Taylor is up for Artist of the Year, Female Artist of the Year and Touring Artist of the Year. You can vote at [theacas.com](http://theacas.com/vote-artistawards.php). Taylor is up for Artist of the Year: Female and Touring Artist of the Year. [Vote vote vote](http://theacas.com/vote-artistawards.php)!

- December 10: The concert dates of August 27 and 28 in Los Angeles, CA at the Staples Center are on sale to the general public on [Ticketmaster](http://www.ticketmaster.com/search?q=taylor+swift) at 10:00am.

- December 12: The Hub will rerun their Taylor Swift special Journey To Fearless.

- December 13: Taylor Swift turns 21 years old 🙂

[Return to the current calendar](https://theswiftagency.com/calendar)

(Sources: [TaylorSwift.com](http://www.taylorswift.com), and way too many to enumerate!)

2009 was Taylor Swift’s year, but someone forgot to tell the Fearless One that was it. She keeps going strong.

[Return to the current calendar](https://theswiftagency.com/calendar)

January

- January 19: Digital release of Today Was A Fairytale on iTunes.

- January 22: Hope for Haiti Telethon on all major networks at 8pm EST. Taylor will be performing live.

- January 27: Taylor will perform at  Unforgettable Evening event in LA, benefiting the EIF’s Women’s Cancer Research Fund.

- January 28: CBS re-runs the CSI episode with Taylor Swift. 9PM ET.

- January 29: She makes an appearance in the Early Show in CBS at 7AM ET.

- January 31: 52nd Grammy Awards in Los Angeles, California. It will be broadcasted on CBS, 8pm -11:30pm ET/PT. Taylor is nominated for 8 awards and scheduled to perform. She won 4: Best Country Song, Best Female Country Vocal, Best Country Album and Album of the Year 🙂

February

- February 4: The Fearless Tour 2010 begins with the Australian tour in Brisbane, Queensland.

- February 6: Australian tour concert in Sydney, New South Wales.

- February 7: Australian tour concert in Sydney, New South Wales.

- February 8: Australian tour concert in Newcastle, New South Wales.

- February 9: Release of the Valentine’s Day movie soundtrack in stores and online.

- February 10: Australian tour concert in Melbourne, Victoria.

- February 11: Australian tour concert in Melbourne, Victoria.

- February 12: Last concert of the Australian tour in Adelaide, Australia.

- February 12: Valentine’s Day movie opens.

- February 16: The 2010 Brit Awards in London, England.

- February 17: First ever Japan tour concert in Tokyo, Japan.

- February 26: [Caitlin Evanson](https://theswiftagency.wordpress.com/2009/11/15/caitlin-evanson/)‘s Birthday

- March 4: The US tour begins in Tampa, Florida.

- March 5: US tour concert in Orlando, Florida.

- October 22: Story Of Us will get a 30-second preview on Comcast On Demand and [XfinityTv.com](http://www.xfinitytv.com/) starting one minute past midnight. E! News will show the clip in the evening.

- October 23: Last chance to send your video entries for the [Team Hug](http://www.teamhug.org/)contest! Closes at 5pm Eastern time.

- October 25: Speak Now WORLDWIDE DATE RELEASE on iTunes and on major music retailers around the world.

- October 25: Tickets go on sale for a lot of tour concert dates! See February and March for ticket links.

- October 25: [103.7 KISS-FM](http://www.1037kissfm.com/) in Milwaukee will be [taken over](http://wxss.taylorswifttakeover.com/) by Taylor Swift at noon.

- October 25: A group of winners of contests held around the world will join Taylor for a private performance at the United Nations in New York City. [Taylor Swift Live Stream from New York City](http://www.cmt.com/shows/events/taylor_swift_live_stream/) will be available on many of MTV Networks’ web properties, including CMT.com, MTV.com, VH1.com and websites across Europe, Asia, Australia and Latin America at 7PM Eastern, 6PM Central. Now also available on [Ustream](http://www.ustream.tv/taylorswift).

- October 25: Taylor Swift takes over [Dial-Global Hot Country Forum](http://www.dial-global.com/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=244:taylor-swift-takes-over-dial-globals-hot-country-format&catid=1:on-the-dial-press&Itemid=92) from 8pm to 9pm EST.

- October 26: Taylor will perform live for fans from Rockefeller Plaza on the [Today Show](http://today.msnbc.msn.com/) as part of their fall concert series. Fans can apply for passes to the show at: [http://today.msnbc.msn.com/id/30012397](http://today.msnbc.msn.com/id/30012397) . That night, she will do an interview and performance on the [Late Show with David Letterman](http://www.cbs.com/late_night/late_show/). The [Today Show](http://today.msnbc.msn.com/) airs on NBC from 7:00 – 11:00 a.m. (all time zones), and [Late Show with David Letterman](http://www.cbs.com/late_night/late_show/) airs on CBS at 11:30 p.m. (ET/PT).

- October 27: Taylor’s day starts with [Live! With Regis & Kelly](http://regisandkelly.go.com/) where she will do an interview and performance. The show airs on ABC affiliates nationwide, check for listings by area. That afternoon, she will visit Scholastic’s New York headquarters, where she will take time out from her busy release week schedule for a special literacy event, [Read Now! with Taylor Swift](http://www.scholastic.com/readeveryday/readnow.htm), as part of the company’s 90th Anniversary Literacy campaign ([register here](http://vxlive.feedroom.com/feedroom/http/4000/5172/5174/7045/Lobby/default.htm)). Later in the day, she will visit Madame Tussaud’s New York – the famed Times Square wax attraction — for the unveiling of her original wax figure.

- October 27: Taylor will now be appearing at the JetBlue terminal, Gate 14 (there is no Gate 13, superstitious much?) at Kennedy International Airport in New York City on Wednesday, October 27. Taylor Swift has a chartered flight from New York to Los Angeles with very lucky fans included and even an improvised concert during the flight.

- October 28:[Ellen DeGeneres Show](http://ellen.warnerbros.com/) will celebrate the release of Speak Now by once again devoting an entire hour-long show to throwing Taylor’s official album release party. Participate in Ellen’s [Ultimate Taylor Swift Fan](http://ellen.warnerbros.com/show/respond/?PlugID=463#ixzz12O0vM7jI) contest!

- October 29: Taylor Swift performs at Hollywood and Highland in Los Angeles, California.

- October 29: The Royal Caribbean International contest [The Allure of Taylor Swift](http://theallureoftaylor.com/#) entry period closes. The cruise dates are tentatively scheduled for January 16-23, 2011. Sorry, only US residents eligible.

November

- November 1: The Speak Now Album Release Party will air on the [Ellen DeGeneres Show](http://ellen.warnerbros.com/) on Monday, November 1st (syndicated, check local listings).

- November 2: Taylor will perform on [Dancing With the Stars](http://abc.go.com/shows/dancing-with-the-stars), airing on ABC at 9:00 p.m. (ET/PT).

- November 4: Taylor gets interviewed on CTV’s Canada AM. Enter 99.9FM’s [contest to be in the audience](http://toronto.virginradio.ca/Channels/listentowin/Story.aspx?ID=1303207)!

- November 4: Taylor Swift will be at the [MuchMusic](http://blog.muchmusic.com/taylor-swift-is-coming-to-muchmusic/) building in Toronto, Canada at 5pm Eastern time.

- November 9: The [BMI Awards](http://www.bmi.com/press/entry/548690).

- November 10: The 44th Annual [CMA Awards](http://www.cmaawards.com/) ceremony takes place live from the Bridgestone Arena in Nashville, TN. The event airs on ABC at 8/7c. Taylor Swift is nominated for Female Vocalist of the Year. She also is scheduled to perform. Update: She lost to Miranda Lambert.

- November 11: The CMA Country Christmas is taped. Taylor is not scheduled to appear but it’s still a major Country Music show.

- November 14: Taylor is scheduled to perform at the [BBC Radio 1’s Teen Awards](http://www.bbc.co.uk/radio1/teenawards/2010/about/).

- November 16: Speak Now is released on vinyl.

- November 17: TV appearance on [Fuji TV/SmapXSmap Japan TV](http://www.fujitv.co.jp/en/).

- November 18: TV appearance on [Nippon TV/Zoom In Japan TV](http://www.ntv.co.jp/english/).

- November 21: The [American Music Awards](http://abc.go.com/shows/american-music-awards) are broadcast live on ABC at 8pm Eastern time. The winners will be decided via online voting through [ABC.com](http://www.ama.abc.com/) and [AMAvote.com](http://www.amavote.com/). Taylor Swift is nominated for Favorite Female Country Artist. Update! Voting is now closed.

- November 22: Taylor Swift will appear on the Tonight Show with Jay Leno. Check your local TV listings.

- November 24: Taylor Swift’s performance of Back To December will air on The Ellen Degeneres Show. Check your local TV listings.

- November 24: Taylor Swift will appear on the Chelsea Lately show. Check your local TV listings.

- November 25: “Taylor Swift – Speak Now” will document the days of the Speak Now album release including a trip from New York City to Los Angeles, her multiple performances, behind the scenes footage and her concert 30,000 feet in the air on a plane ride across the country. The special airs on [NBC](http://www.nbc.com/) at 8PM Eastern Time.

December

- December 1: [E! Entertainment Special](http://www.eonline.com) on Taylor Swift at 10pm Eastern time.

- December 3: Atlanta, Los Angeles, San Jose, Sacramento and Toronto are on sale to the general public on [Ticketmaster](http://www.ticketmaster.com/search?q=taylor+swift) at 10:00am.

- December 3: The first ever [CMT Artists of the Year](http://www.cmt.com/shows/events/artists-of-the-year/index.jhtml) airing Dec. 3 at 8/7c on CMT. Taylor Swift is among the honored ones.

- December 4: Foxborough is on sale to the general public on [Ticketmaster](http://www.ticketmaster.com/search?q=taylor+swift) at 10:00am. Montreal is on sale at [Evenko](http://www.evenko.ca/en/show/event/taylor-swift-4842).

- December 4: The voting for the [American Country Awards](http://theacas.com/vote-artistawards.php) closes. You can vote at [theacas.com](http://theacas.com/vote-artistawards.php). Taylor is up for Artist of the Year: Female and Touring Artist of the Year. [Vote vote vote](http://theacas.com/vote-artistawards.php)!

- December 6: The first ever [American Country Awards](http://theacas.com/vote-artistawards.php) show will air on the Fox Network. Taylor is up for Artist of the Year, Female Artist of the Year and Touring Artist of the Year. You can vote at [theacas.com](http://theacas.com/vote-artistawards.php). Taylor is up for Artist of the Year: Female and Touring Artist of the Year. [Vote vote vote](http://theacas.com/vote-artistawards.php)!

- December 10: The concert dates of August 27 and 28 in Los Angeles, CA at the Staples Center are on sale to the general public on [Ticketmaster](http://www.ticketmaster.com/search?q=taylor+swift) at 10:00am.

- December 12: The Hub will rerun their Taylor Swift special Journey To Fearless.

- December 13: Taylor Swift turns 21 years old 🙂

{NICKI MINAJ} did double duty in Downtown Los Angeles on Sunday night (28Aug11), dashing from the MTV Video Music Awards to join {TAYLOR SWIFT} onstage across the street.
 The R&B star picked up Best Hip-Hop Video prize for Super Bass at the Nokia Theatre awards show and then stunned Swift’s fans at the Staples Center by stepping out for a performance with the country star.
 Sunday’s show ended a four-night stint at the Staples Center for Swift and she made sure it was a star-packed run of shows, welcoming Justin Bieber, comedienne Ellen DeGeneres and Jason Mraz onstage, but it was Sunday’s special guest who brought the house down with a performance of Super Bass.
 Swift danced around and offered up a vocal assist on the chorus.
 After the show, Swift tweeted, “The combination of the INSANE crowd tonight and @NICKIMINAJ joining me onstage for Superbass = #IwishthatIcouldhavethismoment4life.”

- September 5: The [46th Annual CMA Awards](http://www.cmaworld.com/cma-awards) nominations are revealed on Good Morning America at the Hard Rock Cafe on Times Square in New York City.

- [LOS ANGELES, CA – SEPTEMBER 06: Taylor Swift performs onstage during the 2012 MTV Video Music Awards at Staples Center on September 6, 2012 in Los Angeles, California. (Photo by Kevin Mazur/WireImage)
" data-image-caption="(Photo by Kevin Mazur/WireImage)
" data-large-file="https://theswiftagency.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/09/2012-vma-awards-wanegbt-081.jpg?w=672" loading="lazy" title="2012 MTV Video Music Awards - Show" alt="" src="https://theswiftagency.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/09/2012-vma-awards-wanegbt-081.jpg?w=257&h=300" width="257" height="300" srcset="https://theswiftagency.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/09/2012-vma-awards-wanegbt-081.jpg?w=257 257w, https://theswiftagency.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/09/2012-vma-awards-wanegbt-081.jpg?w=514 514w, https://theswiftagency.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/09/2012-vma-awards-wanegbt-081.jpg?w=129 129w" sizes="(max-width: 257px) 100vw, 257px">](https://theswiftagency.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/09/2012-vma-awards-wanegbt-081.jpg)(Photo by Kevin Mazur/WireImage)
September 6: The [2012 MTV Video Music Awards](http://www.mtv.com/ontv/vma/2012/) will air live from Staples Center in Los Angeles at 8 p.m. ET/PT. Taylor Swift is scheduled to perform.

- September 7: The [Stand Up To Cancer](http://standup2cancer.org/) Telethon at 8pm EDT on all major US TV networks. Taylor Swift performs.

- September 9: The [CCMA Awards](http://www.ccma.org/press_release.cfm?PressReleaseID=5701J64C5262AC641) will be broadcasted live across Canada on Sunday September 9th at 8 p.m. on CBC, with encore airings on CMT (Canada) starting at 10 p.m. E.T.

- September 10: Taylor Swift will appear at the [CityTV](http://www.citytv.com/toronto/citynews/test/article/222091--contest-up-close-and-personal-with-taylor-swift) offices in Toronto, Ontario, Canada for an interview about her upcoming album, Red. Be part of the audience by signing up for the [contest](http://www.citytv.com/toronto/citynews/test/article/222091--contest-up-close-and-personal-with-taylor-swift).

- September 13: Taylor Swift performs at the Citibank Hall on Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. More details at [Taylor Swift Brazil](http://taylorswift.com.br/promocao-serenata-de-amor-te-leva-para-o-show-da-taylor-swift/).

- September 16: Red Deluxe Edition is available for pre-order at [Target.com](http://target.com/).

- September 17: The [CMA Music Festival: Country’s Night to Rock](http://www.cmaworld.com/news/newsitemdetail/2012/07/18/summer-s-hottest-concert-special-cma-music-festival-country-s-night-to-rock-features-superstar-performances-from-a-to-z) special hosted by Luke Bryan and the Band Perry’s Kimberly Perry airs at 8|7c on ABC.

- September 22: Taylor Swift performs at the [iHeartRadio Music Festival](http://www.iheartradio.com/cc-common/iheartradio-music-festival/) at MGM Grand in Las Vegas, Nevada.

- September 24: Song preview and intro on Good Morning America on ABC (7 – 9 a.m. ET/PT)

- September 25: 12:01 a.m. ET – Song #1 available for download at iTunes

- September 29: Sony All Access promotional event at the Ryman Auditorium in Nashville.

October

- October 1: song preview and intro on Good Morning America on ABC (7 – 9 a.m. ET/PT)

- October 1: The [CW](http://blog.cwtv.com/2012/07/18/the-cw-to-kick-off-fall-season-with-exclusive-television-broadcast-of-clear-channel%E2%80%99s-iheartradio-music-festival-2012-monday-oct-1-8-10-pm/) will broadcast the iHeartRadio Music Festival from 8pm to 10pm ET.

- October 1: Taylor Swift talks to Nightline on ABC at 11:35pm EST.

- October 2: 12:01 a.m. ET – Song #2 available for download at iTunes

- October 5: [BBC Radio 1’s Nick Grimshaw](http://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/b01mw02d) will interview Taylor Swift.

- October 6: The [Jonathan Ross Show](http://www.itv.com/presscentre/thejonathanrossshow2012/ep08week41/default.html) welcomes Taylor Swift.

- [LONDON, ENGLAND – OCTOBER 07: Taylor Swift performs at the BBC Radio 1 Teen Awards 2012 at Wembley Arena on October 7, 2012 in London. England (Photo by Dave J Hogan/Getty Images)
" data-image-caption="(Photo: Dave J Hogan/Getty Images)
" data-large-file="https://theswiftagency.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/10/bbc-radio-1-teen-choice-036.jpg?w=395" loading="lazy" title="BBC Radio 1 Teen Awards - Show" alt="" src="https://theswiftagency.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/10/bbc-radio-1-teen-choice-036.jpg?w=199&h=300" width="199" height="300" srcset="https://theswiftagency.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/10/bbc-radio-1-teen-choice-036.jpg?w=199 199w, https://theswiftagency.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/10/bbc-radio-1-teen-choice-036.jpg?w=100 100w, https://theswiftagency.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/10/bbc-radio-1-teen-choice-036.jpg 395w" sizes="(max-width: 199px) 100vw, 199px">](https://theswiftagency.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/10/bbc-radio-1-teen-choice-036.jpg)(Photo: Dave J Hogan/Getty Images)
October 7: The [BBC Radio 1′s Teen Awards 2012](http://www.bbc.co.uk/radio1/teenawards/2012/). Taylor Swift has been announced as part of the performing line-up. The show will be streamed at [bbc.co.uk/radio1](http://bbc.co.uk/radio1).

- October 8: song preview and intro on Good Morning America on ABC (7 – 9 a.m. ET/PT)

- October 9: – 12:01 a.m. ET – Song #3 available for download at iTunes

- October 9: Taylor Swift appears in [Glamour](http://www.glamour.com/entertainment/blogs/obsessed/2012/10/taylor-swifts-november-glamour.html) magazine.

- October 14: Taylor Swift performance airs on The X Factor UK.

- October 15: song preview and intro on Good Morning America on ABC (7 – 9 a.m. ET/PT)

- October 15: Taylor Swift performs at the [Harvey Mudd College](http://www.hmc.edu/newsandevents/taylor-swift-concert.html). The performance will be recorded to air as part of the [VH1 Storytellers](http://www.vh1.com) special on November 11.

- October 16: 12:01 a.m. ET – Song #4 available for download at iTunes

- October 18: Taylor Swift will tape and perform at The Ellen DeGeneres Show. The episode is scheduled to air October 25.

- October 20: [Akoo](http://akoo.com/) will become [RED TV](https://www.facebook.com/Akoo/app_396255533778214) for Taylor Swift’s [1-hour special program](https://www.facebook.com/Akoo/app_396255533778214) on the launch of RED.

- https://theswiftagency.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/08/red-cover.jpg(Photo: Sarah Barlow/13 Management)
October 22: Taylor Swift’s fourth album, Red, is released!

- October 22: Taylor appears live on [Good Morning America](http://www.goodmorningamerica.com) for the album launch of Red.

- October 22: [CMT](http://www.cmt.com/news/cmt-offstage/1695916/offstage-taylor-swift-10-places-to-see-red.jhtml)‘s VJ For Day with Taylor Swift at 9am.

- October 22: Part one of Taylor’s interview with [Nan Kelley](http://www.gactv.com/gac/about_us/article/0,,GAC_26085_4727917,00.html) on GAC’s [Top 20 Country Countdown](http://www.gactv.com/top20) at several times starting at 10am ET.

- October 22: Taylor interviews with [Sirius XM “The Highway”](http://www.siriusxm.com/thehighway) at 2pm ET.

- October 22: Interviews on Entertainment Tonight, Access Hollywood, E! News and Extra throughout the week

- October 22: [NML Presents: Taylor Swift Revealed](http://www.newmusiclive.ca/watch-nml-presents-taylor-swift-revealed-on-october-22/) airs at 6pm ET on MuchMusic.

- October 23: Taylor appears live on [Good Morning America](http://www.goodmorningamerica.com) for a live concert.

- October 23: [Late Show with David Letterman](http://www.cbs.com/shows/late_show/) appearance/performance.

- October 24: Taylor Swift is scheduled to appear on [The View](http://theview.abc.go.com/) on ABC.

- October 24: Scholastic’s [Read Every Day](http://www.scholastic.com/readeveryday/taylor-swift-live-webcast.htm) live classroom webcast at 2pm ET / 11am PT.

- October 25: [The Ellen DeGeneres Show](http://www.ellentv.com/) episode with Taylor Swift airs. Check your local listings.

- October 26: Taylor returns to Nashville for the event “Taylor Swift Worldwide Radio Remote” presented by [Papa John’s](http://www.papajohns.com/taylorswift/) with 72 stations broadcasting live from Music City, including stations from South Africa and New Zealand.

- October 26: She will join [Katie Couric](http://www.katiecouric.com/on-the-show/2012/10/26/superstar-taylor-swift/) on ABC’s Katie at 3pm ET.

- October 26: Part two of Taylor’s interview with [Nan Kelley](http://www.gactv.com/gac/about_us/article/0,,GAC_26085_4727917,00.html) on GAC’s [Top 20 Country Countdown](http://www.gactv.com/top20) at 8p|7c.

- October 26: All Access Nashville with Katie Couric airs at 9|8c on ABC. Includes an interview with Taylor Swift.

- October 26: TVA’s [Ça finit bien la semaine](http://tva.canoe.ca/emissions/cafinitbienlasemaine/ongletcafinitbienlasemainecettesemaine) has Taylor Swift’s only interview in Québec at 9pm.

- October 30: She performs in [Dancing With The Stars](abc.go.com/shows/dancing-with-the-stars) on ABC.

http://www.cmaworld.com/cma-awards/

November

- November 1: The [46th CMA Awards](http://www.cmaworld.com/cma-awards) hosted by Brad Paisley and Carrie Underwood airs live on ABC at 8pm ET, 7pm CT. She performed Begin Again. She didn’t win any awards.

- November 6: Taylor Swift will switch on the Christmas lights at [Westfield Shopping Center](http://uk.westfield.com/london/news-and-events/taylor-swift-light-switch-on) in Shepherd’s Bush, West London at 6pm and perform three tracks.

- November 9: Taylor Swift [chats about her new album](http://digiguide.tv/programme-details/Channel+4/9+November+2012/22:00/Alan+Carr%3A+Chatty+Man/Chat+Show/) on the Alan Carr Show in the UK.

- November 11, 12, 13: First concert dates go on presale! [Click here to sign up for pre-sale ticket access](http://eepurl.com/fxqS-/).

- November 11: Taylor Swift appears on[VH1 Storytellers](http://vh1.com/) including a performance at [Harvey Mudd College](http://www.hmc.edu/newsandevents/taylor-swift-concert.html) recorded on October 15.

- November 11: The [2012 MTV EMA](http://mtvema.com/vote) will be broadcast on MTV channels worldwide at 9pm Central European Time.

- November 15: Taylor Swift [performs](http://www.hypable.com/2012/11/08/x-factor-top-12/) State of Grace on the [X-Factor](http://www.thexfactorusa.com/news/article/taylor-swift-to-perform-on-the-x-factor-thursday) at 8pm ET/PT.

- November 16: Tickets go on sale for the first dates announced of the Red Tour. [Click here to sign up for pre-sale ticket access](http://eepurl.com/fxqS-/)

- November 18: The [40th Anniversary American Music Awards](http://vote.abc.go.com/shows/american-music-awards/vote?category=6) air at 8pm Eastern / 7pm Central on ABC. Taylor Swift is nominated for Favorite Female Country Artist. She is also scheduled to perform.

- November 22? Taylor has said in recent interviews she’s spending Thanksgiving in Japan. Also mentioned on [Universal Music Japan’s Taylor Swift page](http://www.universal-music.co.jp/taylor-swift/news/2012/10/1017/).

- November 24:  Taylor is scheduled to appear on Japan’s [Saturday Sound Studio](http://www.interfm.co.jp/taylorswift/) for a special.

- November 26: Taylor Swift is [scheduled to perform](https://twitter.com/RichardWilkins/status/265207828686462976) at Australia’s [The Today Show](http://today.ninemsn.com/).

- November 29: Taylor Swift is [scheduled to perform](http://www.noise11.com/news/taylor-swift-to-perform-at-aria-awards-20121007) at the [2012 ARIA Awards](http://www.ariaawards.com.au/) in Sydney, Australia.

- November 30: Taylor Swift’s past performance of Begin Again airs on [The Ellen DeGeneres Show](http://ellentv.com).

December

- December 1 & 2: Taylor Swift guest hosts on [American Top 40](http://www.at40.com/news-article/taylor-swift-is-guest-hosting-at40-this-weekend/23812).
https://theswiftagency.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/01/grammy-swift-ll-cool-j-promo.jpg(Source: CBS)

- December 1: [KIIS FM’s Jingle Ball 2012](http://www.kiisfm.com/pages/events/jingleball12/) at the Nokia Theatre in Los Angeles. Taylor Swift is scheduled to perform on Saturday.

- December 3: Taylor Swift will be honored at the [Ripple of Hope Awards Dinner](http://rippleofhope.eventbrite.com/) taking place at the Marriott Marquis in New York City. The event is organized by the [Robert F. Kennedy Center for Justice and Human Rights](http://rfkcenter.org/2012gala-12).

- December 5: Taylor Swift will co-host the [Grammy](http://www.grammy.com/news/taylor-swift-to-co-host-the-grammy-nominations-concert-live) nominations concert with LL Cool J on CBS at  10pm ET/PT, 9pm CT.

- December 7: [Z100′s Jingle Ball 2012](http://www.z100.com/pages/events/jingleball12/) at Madison Square Garden in New York City. Taylor Swift is in the lineup.

- December 10: The [American Country Awards](http://theacas.com/signin.aspx) take place in Las Vegas and broadcast on FOX. Taylor Swift is nominated for Artist of the Year, Best Female Artist, Single of the Year, Best Female Single and Best Female Video. Update! No wins.http://theacas.com/signin.aspx

- December 13: No, seriously, you don’t know? I mean, really! How many times are we going to go over this?

- December 13: The music video for I Knew You Were Trouble will premiere at 4:40 p.m. ET on MTV.

- December 15: Taylor Swift will be the musical guest on the German TV show [Schlag Den Raab](http://www.prosieben.de/tv/schlag-den-raab/schlag-raab-15-dezember-musikacts-1.3456976/).

- December 21: [Claire Callaway](https://theswiftagency.com/profiles/claire-callaway/)‘s Birthday.

- December 22: The [World Music Awards](http://www.worldmusicawards.com/) has nominated Taylor Swift for World’s Best Album, Song, Video, Female Artist, Live Act and Entertainer of the Year.

- December 31: Taylor Swift headlines at [Dick Clark’s New Year’s Rockin’ Eve with Ryan Seacrest](http://dickclark.com/category/shows/dick-clarks-new-years-rockin-eve-with-ryan-seacrest/).

[Return to the current calendar](https://theswiftagency.com/calendar)

January

- January 11: [People’s Choice Awards 2012](http://www.peopleschoice.com/pca/nominations/). Taylor Swift was nominated for Favorite Country Artist, Favorite Female Artist and Favorite Tour Headliner. Update: She won for Favorite Country Artist.

- January 26: The [47th ACM Awards](http://www.acmcountry.com) nominees were announced. Taylor Swift is nominated for Entertainer of the Year, Female Vocalist of the Year and Video of the Year for “Mean”. Voting for Entertainer of the Year starts March 19!

February

- February 7: Taylor Connect, the forums at [taylorswift.com](http://taylorswift.com) come back online!

- February 12: The [54th Annual Grammy Awards](http://www.grammy.com/) take place at the Staples Center in Los Angeles. Taylor Swift won for Best Country Song for “Mean” and Best Country Solo Performance for “Mean”. She also performed! The show was broadcast live on CBS from 8:00pm to 11:30pm ET/PT.

- February 13: The music video for Safe And Sound debuts on MTV and across all Viacom’s partner networks.

- February 19: The world premiere of Dr. Seuss’ The Lorax at Universal Studios Hollywood, Universal City, California. Director Chris Renaud and cast members Danny DeVito, Ed Helms, Zac Efron, Taylor Swift, Rob Riggle, Jenny Slate and Betty White will be attending.

- February 20: Taylor Swift is scheduled to appear on the Tonight Show with Jay Leno on NBC.

- February 21: Taylor Swift and Zac Efron are scheduled to appear on [The Ellen Degeneres Show](http://ellen.warnerbros.com/2012/02/zac_efron_and_taylor_swift_-_tuesday_february_21_2012.php).

- February 26: [Caitlin Evanson](https://theswiftagency.com/profiles/caitlin-evanson/)‘s Birthday.

March

- March 2: The Lorax is released nationwide to theaters in US and Canada.

- March 2: Speak Now Tour in Perth, Australia at Burswood Dome.

- March 4: Speak Now Tour in Adelaide, Australia at Adelaide Entertainment Centre.

- March 6: Speak Now Tour in Brisbane, Australia at Brisbane Entertainment Centre.

- March 7: Speak Now Tour in Brisbane, Australia at Brisbane Entertainment Centre.

- March 9: Speak Now Tour in Sydney, Australia at Allphones Arena.

- March 10: Speak Now Tour in Sydney, Australia at Allphones

- March 12: Speak Now tour in Melbourne, Australia at Rod Laver Arena.

- March 13: Speak Now Tour in Melbourne, Australia at Rod Laver Arena.

- March 14: Speak Now Tour in Melbourne, Australia at Rod Laver Arena.

- March 16: Speak Now Tour in Auckland, New Zealand at Vector Arena.

- March 17: Speak Now Tour in Auckland, New Zealand at Vector Arena.

- March 18: [Amos Heller](https://theswiftagency.com/profiles/amos-heller/)‘s Birthday.

- March 18: Speak Now Tour in Auckland, New Zealand at  Vector Arena.

- March 19: The voting for ACM Entertainer of the Year for the [47th ACM Awards](http://www.VoteACM.com) begins!

- March 20: [The Hunger Games: Songs From District 12 And Beyond](http://itunes.apple.com/us/album/hunger-games-songs-from-district/id509605019?uo=4) music soundtrack album is released.

- March 23: Taylor Swift is scheduled to appear on [Live! With Kelly](http://www.dadt.com/live/). Update!  Looks like this is a repeat.

- March 23: The Hunger Games movie is released nationwide.

- March 29: The [Punk’d](http://www.mtv.com/shows/punkd/series.jhtml) season premiere episode featuring Taylor Swift airs on [MTV](http://www.mtv.com/shows/punkd/series.jhtml) at 10/9c.

- March 31: The 2012 [Kids Choice Awards](http://www.nick.com/kids-choice-awards/2012/nominees). Taylor was nominated for Favorite Female Singer and Favorite Song for Sparks Fly. The show airs on Nickelodeon on Saturday, March 31st at 8/7c. Update! She only won the Big Help Award given to her by Michelle Obama.

- April 23: Little Big Town announces the 2012 CMT Awards nominations live on NBC’s Today.

- April 30: [Grant Mickelson](https://theswiftagency.com/profiles/grant-mickelson/)‘s Birthday.

May

- May 14: The CMA Fest online entry form period to win tickets to meet and greet lines at Fan Fair Hall opens at [CMAfest.com](http://cmaworld.informz.net/z/cjUucD9taT0xNjA1ODIyJnA9MSZ1PTc3NTUxNDE1MyZsaT03NDcyMjQw/index.html).

- May 20: The [2012 Billboard Awards](http://billboard.com/bbma) takes place in Las Vegas and is broadcasted live at 8/7c on ABC. Taylor Swift is nominated for Top Country Artist and Top Touring Artist. Update! She won Woman of the Year.

- May 21: Tickets go on sale for the [2012 CMT Music Awards](http://www.cmt.com/cmt-music-awards/categories.jhtml) at 10am Central Standard Time.

- May 27:[Elizabeth Huett](https://theswiftagency.com/profiles/elizabeth-huett/)‘s Birthday.

- May 28: The CMA Fest online entry form period to win tickets to meet and greet lines at Fan Fair Hall closes at [CMAfest.com](http://cmaworld.informz.net/z/cjUucD9taT0xNjA1ODIyJnA9MSZ1PTc3NTUxNDE1MyZsaT03NDcyMjQw/index.html).

June

- June 1: The notification of the passes to the Fan Fair Hall meet and greet lines are sent out. The passes are picked up at the CMA Fest.

- June 4: Last chance to [vote](http://www.cmt.com/cmt-music-awards/categories.jhtml) for the [2012 CMT Music Awards](http://www.cmt.com/cmt-music-awards/categories.jhtml).
http://www.cmafest.com(Source: CMAFest.com)

- June 5: Carrie Underwood’s Fan Club Party at the Grand Ole Opry.

- June 6: The [Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum](http://countrymusichalloffame.org/recent-press-releases/view/1916) opens the exhibit [Taylor Swift: Speak Now – Treasures from the World Tour](http://countrymusichalloffame.org/recent-press-releases/view/1916). It will include dozens of costumes, instruments, set pieces and props from the Speak Now World Tour. The exhibit runs from June 6 through November 4, 2012.

- June 6: The [2012 CMT Music Awards](http://www.cmt.com/cmt-music-awards/categories.jhtml) will air live from Nashville on CMT. Taylor Swift is nominated for Video of the Year and Collaborative Video of the Year both along with the Civil Wars for Safe And Sound and Female Video of the Year for Ours. You can [vote now](http://www.cmt.com/cmt-music-awards/categories.jhtml).

- June 7: [Mallary Hope’s Fan Club Party](http://mallaryhopefans.com/announcing-the-2012-mallary-hope-fan-club-party) at Puckett’s Restaurant happens from 2pm to 4pm.

- June 7-10: The 2012[CMA Music Festival](http://www.cmaworld.com/cma-music-festival/tickets/2012-tickets) takes place from June 7 to June 10. Taylor Swift is not in the lineup so far.

- June 9: [Amos Heller](https://theswiftagency.com/profiles/amos-heller) performs with Old Dominion at [12th and Porter](http://12thandporterlive.com/) at 10:30pm.

- June 15: [Rocco’s Old School presents: Tequila Sunrise – A Tribute to the Eagles](http://www.livenation.com/event/050048A4ADCE9299?artistid=1730182&majorcatid=10001&minorcatid=52) at [House of Blues Cleveland](http://www.houseofblues.com/venues/clubvenues/cleveland/). Tickets go on sale Friday, May 11 at 10am ET on [LiveNation.com](http://www.livenation.com/event/050048A4ADCE9299?artistid=1730182&majorcatid=10001&minorcatid=52).

- June 27: B.o.B premieres his video for Both Of Us featuring Taylor Swift on MTV. The video should premiere at 6am CDT and be shown between shows throughout the day.

July

- July 2: James Taylor performs at [Tanglewood](http://tanglewood.org) with a surprise and possibly Sparkly Dressed guest.

- July 9: Ryan Seacrest announces the lineup for the [iHeartRadio Music Festival](http://www.iheartradio.com/cc-common/iheartradio-music-festival/) on [iHeartRadio](http://www.iheart.com/) at 9am Eastern Time.

- July 14: Tickets for the [iHeartRadio Music Festival](http://www.iheartradio.com/cc-common/iheartradio-music-festival/) are available on [Ticketmaster](http://www.ticketmaster.com/iHeartRadio-Music-Festival-tickets/artist/1616924) at 1PM Eastern Time.

- July 22: The [Teen Choice Awards 2012](http://teenchoiceawards.com/index.aspx) air live (8:00-10:00 PM ET live/PT tape-delayed) on FOX. - January 23: Taylor Swift appears in the Spain’s network [Antena 3](http://www.antena3.com/programas/el-hormiguero/invitados/taylor-swift-visita-hormiguero_2013011500176.html) show [El Hormiguero](http://www.antena3.com/programas/el-hormiguero/invitados/taylor-swift-visita-hormiguero_2013011500176.html).

February

Taylor has three nominations: Record of the Year for We Are Never Ever Getting Back Together, Best Country Duo/Group Performance with the Civil Wars and Best Song Written For Visual Media for Safe and Sound with the Civil Wars and T. Bone Burnett. She is scheduled to perform. Update! She won for Best Song Written For Visual Media for Safe and Sound.

- February 19: Taylor appears in the pages of the March issue of [ELLE Magazine](http://www.elle.com/pop-culture/cover-shoots/taylor-swift-quotes-fashion-photos).

- February 20: Taylor is nominated for International Female Solo Artist for the [BRIT Awards 2013](http://www.brits.co.uk/). She will be performing.

- February 22: Taylor Swift [tapes](http://www.lostintv.com/tv-show?id=410) a performance for [Let’s Dance For Comic Relief](http://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/b00z1q37) to be aired on March 9nd.

- February 22: Taylor Swift appears on BBC One’s [The Graham Norton Show](http://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/b01qxpq4).

- February 26: [Caitlin Evanson](https://theswiftagency.com/profiles/caitlin-evanson/)‘s Birthday.

March

- March 13: The music video for 22 will get a 30 second preview on Good Morning America. It will be available  online at [ABC News](http://www.abcnews.com/) and [Good Morning America](http://gma.yahoo.com/) at 8:30 a.m. ET. - March 18 and 19: The Red Tour at Scottrade Center in St. Louis, Missouri.

- March 22: The Red Tour at Time Warner Cable Arena in Charlotte, North Carolina.

- March 23: The Red Tour at [Colonial Life Arena](http://www.coloniallifearena.com/events/eventpages/435.asp#.UQC65EpFeUc) in Columbia, South Carolina.

- March 27, 28 and 29: The Red Tour at Prudential Center in Newark, New Jersey.

- April 7: The [48th ACM Awards](http://www.acmcountry.com/) air from Las Vegas, Nevada at 8pm ET/PT on CBS.

- April 8: [ACM Presents: Tim McGraw’s Superstar Summer Night](http://www.cbs.com/shows/acm-presents-tim-mcgraws-superstar-summer-night/) at the MGM Grand Hotel in Las Vegas, NV.

- https://theswiftagency.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/03/the-red-tour.jpgApril 10: The Red Tour at American Airlines Arena in Miami, Florida.

- April 11 and 12: The Red Tour at Amway Center in Orlando, Florida.

- April 18 and 19: The Red Tour at Philips Arena in Atlanta, Georgia.

- April 20: The Red Tour at Tampa Bay Times Forum in Tampa, Florida.

- April 25: The Red Tour at [Quicken Loans Arena](http://theqarena.com/events/swift-130425/) in Cleveland, Ohio.

- April 26: The Red Tour at Bankers Life Fieldhouse in Indianapolis, Indiana.

- April 27: The Red Tour at Rupp Arena in Lexington, Kentucky.

- April 30: [Grant Mickelson](https://theswiftagency.com/profiles/grant-mickelson/)‘s Birthday.

May

- May 2: [Daniel Sadownick](https://theswiftagency.com/profiles/daniel-sadownick)‘s Birthday.

- https://theswiftagency.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/03/the-red-tour.jpgMay 4: The Red Tour at Ford Field in Detroit, Michigan.

- May 6: Tim McGraw premieres the video for Highway Don’t Care on a Google+ Hangout and streamed on [YouTube.com/TimMcGraw](http://www.youtube.com/TIMMCGRAW) at 4pm CST.

- May 7: The Red Tour at KFC Yum Center in Louisville, Kentucky.

- May 8: The Red Tour at Nationwide Arena in Columbus, Ohio.

- May 11 and 12: The Red Tour at Verizon Center in Washington, D.C.

- May 13: [Paul Sidoti](http://www.theswiftagency.com/profiles/paul_sidoti)‘s Birthday.

- May 14: Taylor Swift makes a cameo on the finale of [New Girl](http://www.fox.com/new-girl/) on Fox Networks. Check your local listings.

- May 16: The Red Tour at [Houston Toyota Center](http://www.houstontoyotacenter.com/events/event_1365.php) in Houston, Texas.

- May 19: The [2013 Billboard Music Awards](http://www.billboard.com/milestone/vote) will be broadcast live on ABC at 8/7c from the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas. Taylor performs. Update! She won 8 awards including Billboard Artist of the Year.

- May 19: [ACM Presents: Tim McGraw’s Superstar Summer Night](http://www.cbs.com/shows/acm-presents-tim-mcgraws-superstar-summer-night/) airs on CBS at 9/8c. Recorded at the MGM Grand Hotel in Las Vegas, NV back on April 9.

- May 21: The Red Tour at [Frank Erwin Center](http://www.uterwincenter.com/events/2013/taylor-swift) in Austin, Texas.

- May 22: The Red Tour at AT&T Center in San Antonio, Texas.

- May 25: The Red Tour at Cowboys Stadium in Arlington, Texas.

- May 27: [Elizabeth Huett](https://theswiftagency.com/profiles/elizabeth-huett/)‘s Birthday.

- May 28 and 29: The Red Tour at Jobing.com Arena in Glendale, Arizona.

June

- June 1: The Red Tour at [EnergySolutions Arena](http://www.energysolutionsarena.com/calendar.cfm?fuseaction=ViewEventDetails&EventID=491) in Salt Lake City, Utah.

- June 2: The Red Tour at [Pepsi Center](http://www.pepsicenter.com/features/taylor-swift/) in Denver, Colorado.

- June 5: The [2013 CMT Music Awards](http://www.cmt.com/cmt-music-awards/).

- June 6 – 9: The [2013 CMA Music Festival](http://www.cmaworld.com/cma-music-festival/2013/home) takes place in Nashville, TN. Taylor Swift performs at LP Field on June 6.

- June 8: Taylor Swift and Ed Sheeran play on the live finale of [Britain’s Got Talent](http://talent.itv.com/), according to [Tellymix](http://tellymix.co.uk/reality-tv/britains-got-talent/149475-britains-got-talent-2013-final-taylor-swift-ed-sheeran-to-perform-on-last-live-show.html).

- June 9: Taylor will perform at [Capital FM’s Summertime Ball 2013](http://www.capitalfm.com/artists/taylor-swift/news/summertime-ball-2013-line-up/).

- June 14 & 15: The Red Tour at [Rogers Centre](http://www.rogerscentre.com/) in Toronto, Ontario.

- June 16: The Enchantress is nominated for the [2013 MuchMusic Video Awards](http://mmva.muchmusic.com/nominees/). She won for Your Fave International Artist/Group. She introduced Ed Sheeran’s performance.

- June 22: The Red Tour at Investors Group Field in Winnipeg, Manitoba.

- June 25 & 26: The Red Tour at Rexall Place in Edmonton, Alberta.

- June 29: The Red Tour at BC Place in Vancouver, B.C.

- June 30: [David Cook](https://theswiftagency.com/profiles/david-cook/) performs with [Morgan James](http://www.morganjamesonline.com/) at the [Montreal Jazz Festival](http://www.montrealjazzfest.com/artists/artist.aspx?id=8059).

[The RED Tour

- July 1: [David Cook](https://theswiftagency.com/profiles/david-cook/) performs with [Morgan James](http://www.morganjamesonline.com/) at the [Montreal Jazz Festival](http://www.montrealjazzfest.com/artists/artist.aspx?id=8059).

- July 4: Taylor Swift pre-recorded performance on NBC’s special coverage of [Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks](http://social.macys.com/fireworks/?cm_mmc=VanityUrl-_-fireworks-_-n-_-n#/about/taylorswift).

- July 6: The Red Tour at Heinz Field in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.

- July 13: The Red Tour at Metlife Stadium in East Rutherford, New Jersey.

- July 26 and 27: The Red Tour at Gillette Stadium in Foxborough, Massachusetts.

August

- Aug. 1: The Red Tour at [Wells Fargo Arena](http://www.iowaeventscenter.com/wells-fargo-arena/) in Des Moines, Iowa.

- Aug. 2 and 3: The Red Tour at Sprint Center in Kansas City, Missouri.

- https://theswiftagency.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/03/the-red-tour.jpgAug 6: The Civil Wars release their eponymous second album, [The Civil Wars](https://itunes.apple.com/us/album/the-civil-wars/id656406080?uo=4).

- Aug. 6: The Red Tour at [Intrust Bank Arena](http://www.intrustbankarena.com/events.asp?id=11&pid=486&task=display) in Wichita, Kansas.

- Aug. 7: The Red Tour at [BOK Center](http://www.bokcenter.com/events/detail/taylor-swift-1) in Tulsa, Oklahoma.

- Aug. 10: The Red Tour at Soldier Field in Chicago, Illinois.

- August 11: Taylor Swift has 7 nominations for the [Teen Choice Awards](http://www.teenchoiceawards.com/index.aspx) (8:00-10:00 PM ET live/PT tape-delayed) on FOX. Update! She won Choice Female Country Artistand Choice Country Song for ”We Are Never Ever Getting Back Together”.

- August 12: [David Cook](https://theswiftagency.com/profiles/david-cook/)‘s Birthday.

- http://www.cmaworld.com/cma-music-festival/2013/about/tv-specialAugust 12: [CMA Music Festival: Country’s Night To Rock](http://www.cmaworld.com/cma-music-festival/2013/about/tv-special) hosted by Little Big Town. Taylor Swift performs.

- Aug. 15: The Red Tour at Valley View Casino Center (formerly San Diego Sports Arena) in San Diego, California.

- Aug. 19 and 20: The Red Tour at Staples Center in Los Angeles, California.

- Aug 23 and 24: The Red Tour at Staples Center in Los Angeles, California.

- Aug 25: [2013 MTV VMA](http://www.mtv.com/ontv/vma/). Update! T-Swizzle won Best Female Video for I Knew You Were Trouble.

- Aug. 27: The Red Tour in Sacramento, California.

- Aug. 30: The Red Tour at [Rose Quarter](http://www.rosequarter.com/EventDetail/tabid/146/rqeventid/829/Default.aspx) in Portland, Oregon.

- Aug. 31: The Red Tour at Tacoma Dome in Tacoma, Washington.

September

- Sept. 6: The Red Tour at [Fargodome](http://www.fargodome.com/events_view.php?id=259) in Fargo, North Dakota.

- https://theswiftagency.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/03/the-red-tour.jpgSept. 7 and 8: The Red Tour at XCel Energy Center in St. Paul, Minnesota.

- Sept. 12: The Red Tour at Greensboro Coliseum Complex in Greensboro, North Carolina.

- Sept. 13: The Red Tour at PNC Arena in Raleigh, North Carolina.

- Sept. 14: The Red Tour at John Paul Jones Arena in Charlottesville, Virginia.

- September 19: The Red Tour at Bridgestone Arena in Nashville, Tennessee.

- September 20: The Red Tour at Bridgestone Arena in Nashville, Tennessee.

- September 21: The Red Tour Grand Finale at Bridgestone Arena in Nashville, Tennessee.

November

- November 3: Taylor Swift and Gary Lightbody perform “The Last Time” on [X Factor UK](http://www.itv.com/presscentre/ep16week45/x-factor#.UmkuanVDsam).

- November 3: The [YouTube Music Awards](http://www.youtube.com/user/YouTube). Taylor wins YouTube Phenomenon for [I Knew You Were Trouble](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D82vG70R7is).

- November 5: The final [2014 People’s Choice nominations](http://www.peopleschoice.com/pca/nominations/) are announced. Taylor Swift is nominated for Country Artist of the Year.

- https://theswiftagency.com/wp-content/uploads/2010/01/47th-annual-cma-awards-logo.jpgNovember 6: The [47th CMA Awards](http://www.cmaawards.com/) at the Bridgestone Arena in Nashville, TN. Taylor is scheduled to perform. She received the Pinnacle Award and won both Musical Event of the Year and Music Video of the Year for ”Highway Don’t Care” with Tim McGraw and Keith Urban.

- November 7: Mallary Hope opens for Charlie Daniels at the Municipal Auditorium in Greenville, TX. [Click here](http://www.ticketfly.com/purchase/event/375919/tfly) for ticket information.

- November 10: It’s the four year anniversary of this blog thing!

- November 14: The [2013 Billboard Touring Awards](http://www.billboard.com/articles/news/5763197/billboard-touring-awards-finalists-rolling-stones-taylor-swift-pink-bon-jovi?page=0%2C1) take place at the Roosevelt Hotel in New York City, NY. Update! Taylor Swift’s RED Tour won for the Top Package Award.

- November 20: Mallary Hope opens for Corey Smith at the House of Blues in West Hollywood, CA. [Click here](http://concerts.livenation.com/event/09004B33CB62AFD2) for ticket information.

- November 21: Mallary Hope opens for Corey Smith at the House of Blues in San Diego, CA. [Click here](http://concerts.livenation.com/event/0A004B33CFDE5AB7) for ticket information.

- November 22: Mallary Hope opens for Corey Smith at the House of Blues in Anaheim, CA. [Click here](http://concerts.livenation.com/event/09004B30EC88C525) for ticket information.

- http://www.theamas.com/November 24: The [2013 American Music Awards](http://www.theamas.com/) air live. Taylor won for: Artist of the Year, Favorite Female Artist – Pop/Rock, Favorite Female Artist – Country and Favorite Album – Country for RED.

- November 26: Taylor Swift performed at the [Centrepoint Winter Whites Gala](http://www.centrepoint.org.uk/winterwhitesgala) at Kensington Palace in London, UK.

- November 29: The RED Tour at Vector Arena in Auckland, New Zealand.

- November 30: The RED Tour at Vector Arena in Auckland, New Zealand.

December

- https://theswiftagency.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/03/the-red-tour.jpgDecember 1: The RED Tour at Vector Arena in Auckland, New Zealand.

- December 4: The RED Tour at Allianz Stadium in Sydney, Australia.

- December 6: The GRAMMY nominations are announced. Taylor performs from Sydney (pre-taped) and is nominated for: 

Album of the Year for RED.

- Best Country Album for RED.

- Best Country Duo/Group Performance for “Highway Don’t Care” along with Tim McGraw and Keith Urban.

- Best Country Song for “Begin Again”.

- December 7: The RED Tour at Suncorp Stadium in Brisbane, Australia.

- December 10: The [2013 American Country Awards](http://theacas.com/signin.aspx) on FOX. Taylor Swift won for World Wide Artist of the Year, Single of the Year: Vocal Collaboration: “Highway Don’t Care,” with Tim McGraw and Keith Urban, Music Video of the Year: Group or Collaboration: “Highway Don’t Care,” with Tim McGraw and Keith Urban.

- December 10: [Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show](http://www.cbs.com/shows/victorias_secret/) airs on CBS. Taylor performed on the show, recorded on November 13.

- December 11: The RED Tour at nib Stadium in Perth, Australia.

- December 13: Happy Birthday, Sparkly Dressed!

- December 14: The RED Tour at Etihad Stadium in Melbourne, Australia.
